purpose: Proposed fixed-input warm serving diagnostic only; not a closed-loop reader or semantic-quality evaluation. No inference dispatched.

source.selection: Unchanged payloads from reserved request 2 and 6 in the same historical paper-reader episode; canonical JSON SHA-256 uses sorted keys, UTF-8, compact separators.

limitations: Historical weak/failed tool-use context is retained; do not interpret output validity or speed as useful-answer quality.
Exact payloads remain in ignored local profile-payloads.json; no paper text is redistributed here.
Match the local tokenizer/chat template before any future dispatch. Old raw local token counts were wrong; use the separately recomputed values here only as historical observations.
Reserve 7168 input plus 1024 output per dispatch; proposed total 10 requests includes 2 warmups and 8 measured requests.
Fixed saved inputs cannot measure how an agent responds to new feedback or finishes a research task.
